career_ladder.note: Technical Officers in FSSAI constitute the central scientific and technical workforce responsible for framing national food safety standards, reviewing Codex guidelines, evaluating food additives and contaminants, managing National Referral Food Laboratories, and drafting safety protocols under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. Technical Officers advance through scientific and administrative grades up to Advisor level.

steps.source_label: FSSAI Recruitment Notice DR-04/2021 — Technical Officer (Pay Level 7)
FSSAI Regulations — Group A Scientific & Regulatory Posts

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment to Technical Officer in FSSAI is conducted through a two-stage examination process: CBT Stage 1 (Computer Based Screening Examination) and CBT Stage 2 (Written Technical Examination), followed by Document Verification. Marking scheme: 4 marks for each correct answer and negative marking of 1 mark for each incorrect answer.

stages.stage_name: CBT Stage 1: Computer Based Screening Examination
stages.source_label: FSSAI — Scheme of Examination for Technical Officer (DR-04/2021)

papers.paper_name: Part A: General Aptitude (General Intelligence 10 Qs, General Awareness 10 Qs, English 10 Qs, Computer Literacy 10 Qs)
papers.negative_marking: +4 marks for correct, -1 mark for wrong answer
papers.qualifying_threshold: Screening examination to shortlist candidates for Stage 2 in 1:20 ratio

papers.paper_name: Part B: Functional Knowledge (Indian & International Food Laws 20 Qs, FSSAI Structure & Functions 20 Qs, Subject Matter Knowledge - Chemistry/Microbiology/Biochemistry/Food Tech 40 Qs)
papers.negative_marking: +4 marks for correct, -1 mark for wrong answer
papers.qualifying_threshold: Combined aggregate score out of 480 determines shortlisting to Stage 2

stages.source_label: FSSAI — CBT Stage 2 Technical Syllabus & Assessment Scheme

papers.paper_name: Specialized Technical Paper (Food Processing, Testing & Analysis, Food Additives, Toxicology, Microbiology, Risk Assessment)
papers.negative_marking: +4 marks for correct, -1 mark for wrong answer (80 questions)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Final merit drawn 100% on CBT Stage 2 marks followed by Document Verification

financial_package.pay_source_label: FSSAI Recruitment Notice DR-04/2021 — Pay Matrix Level 7 (₹44,900 - ₹1,42,400)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated based on 7th CPC Level 7 entry basic pay of ₹44,900. Dearness Allowance at canonical 58% equals ₹26,042. House Rent Allowance ranges from ₹4,490 (10% in Z-class towns) to ₹13,470 (30% in X-class cities like New Delhi headquarters). Transport Allowance ranges from ₹2,844 to ₹5,688 (with 58% DA). Monthly deductions include National Pension System (10% of Basic + DA = ₹7,094), CGHS, and standard taxes.
official_perks: Central Government residential quarters or House Rent Allowance (up to 30% in metropolitan cities)
Transport Allowance and official travel reimbursement for laboratory audits and scientific conferences
Comprehensive medical coverage under Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS)
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and annual paid leave entitlements
Defined contribution benefits under National Pension System (NPS) with 14% employer contribution and Central Government Gratuity
Children Education Allowance (CEA) and annual hostel subsidy
